unit.why: This is a single praise-statement attributed to R. Hayyim Halberstam of Sanz: he said he had known 'our master' as a holy man since his youth. Nothing happens to anyone, so it is not a narrative.
unit.boundary_note: part of a numbered series of praises of the tsaddik (items ו, ז …); the previous division (ה) holds a short anecdote, and this item stands alone
